parameters.help_en: The display name of the playbook
parameters.name: display_name

parameters.help_en:
The UUID of the playbook to copy.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/3000306.html operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
要复制的剧本UUID。
调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/3000306.html接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: source_playbook_uuid

parameters.help_en:
The release version of the playbook to copy. Default value: 0. Valid values:
-1: the version currently being edited.

0: the latest published version of the playbook.
When SourcePlaybookUuid points to a preset playbook (which you can verify by checking the OwnType field returned by DescribePlaybooks), set ReleaseVersion to 0. Preset playbooks do not have editable draft versions. Setting ReleaseVersion to -1 causes the request to fail
parameters.help_zh:
要复制剧本的发布版本，默认为0。 取值：
-1：代表正在编辑中的版本。

0：当前剧本的线上最新发布版本。
当 SourcePlaybookUuid 指向 preset 类型 playbook（可通过 DescribePlaybooks 的 OwnType 字段确认）时，应使用 ReleaseVersion=0，preset playbook 不存在可编辑草稿版本，传 ReleaseVersion=-1 会导致请求失败
parameters.name: release_version

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:

zh (default): Chinese.

en: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型。取值：

zh：（默认）：中文。

en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The view type. Valid values:

0 (default): the current account view.

1: the global account view
parameters.help_zh:
视图类型。取值：

0（默认）：当前账号视图。

1：全局账号视图
parameters.name: role_type

parameters.help_en: The user ID of the member to which the administrator switches the view
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

Data.description_en:
The response data.
In practice, the Data object typically returns only the PlaybookUuid field. Other fields (DisplayName, OwnType, Active, LastRuntime, Permission, GmtCreate, GmtModified, HistoryMd5, SuccNum, FailNum, FailRate, InputParams, OutputParams, Description, LogicReleaseTaskflowMd5, PlaybookStatus, TenantId) may not be returned
Data.description_zh:
返回结果信息。
实际调用中，Data 对象通常仅返回 PlaybookUuid 字段，其余字段（DisplayName、OwnType、Active、LastRuntime、Permission、GmtCreate、GmtModified、HistoryMd5、SuccNum、FailNum、FailRate、InputParams、OutputParams、Description、LogicReleaseTaskflowMd5、PlaybookStatus、TenantId）可能不返回

Active.description_en:
The enabled status of the playbook. Valid values:

1: The playbook is enabled.

0: The playbook is disabled
Active.description_zh:
剧本的启用状态。取值：

1：剧本已启用。

0：剧本未启用

Description.example: This is a action of processing for WAF

DisplayName.description_en: The name of the copied playbook

FailNum.description_en: The number of failed executions of the playbook

FailRate.description_en: The execution failure rate of the playbook

GmtCreate.description_en: The creation time of the playbook. Format: 13-digit timestamp
GmtCreate.description_zh: 剧本创建时间。格式：13位的时间戳

GmtModified.description_en: The modification time of the playbook. Format: 13-digit timestamp
GmtModified.description_zh: 剧本修改时间。格式：13位的时间戳

HistoryMd5.description_en: The number of historical versions of the playbook

InputParams.description_en: The input parameters of the playbook

LastRuntime.description_en: The last execution time of the playbook. Format: 13-digit timestamp
LastRuntime.description_zh: 剧本的最后执行时间。格式：13位的时间戳

LogicReleaseTaskflowMd5.description_en: The MD5 hash of the published version of the playbook

OutputParams.description_en: The output parameters of the playbook

OwnType.description_en:
The type of the playbook. Valid values:

preset: predefined playbook.

user: custom playbook
OwnType.description_zh:
剧本的类型。取值：

preset：预定义剧本。

user：自定义剧本

Permission.description_en:
The operation permission on the playbook. Valid values:

1: not editable, view-only.

2: editable
Permission.description_zh:
剧本的操作权限。取值：

1：不可编辑，可查看

2：可编辑

PlaybookUuid.description_en: The UUID of the copied playbook

SuccNum.description_en: The number of successful executions of the playbook

TenantId.description_en: The user ID of the tenant to which the playbook belongs

PageNumber.description_en: The current page number in the paged query
PageNumber.description_zh: 分页查询时，当前页的页码

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page in the paged query
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时，每页显示的条目数量

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for this request. You can use it to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
